newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end higher on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end higher on weak yen.

text.p: All months of Tokyo aluminium futures ended higher on Thursday, mainly due to the yen's weaker sentiment against the dollar, traders said.
Prices were 2.1 to 2.4 yen higher, with the benchmark February up 2.4 yen at 209 yen per kg. The day's volume was 8,897 lots.

All contracts gained at the opening, as the yen's weaker mood encouraged local investors to buy actively, traders said. "Trading was more active than Wednesday or Tuesday," a brokerage house trader said.

Three contracts -- the October 1997, the December 1997 and the February 1998 -- are currently traded in the Tokyo aluminium futures market. The backwardation between the October and the February was 1.7 yen at the day's closing.
